issues.issue: Whether the RPD should have held an oral hearing on appeal
issues.applicant_position: Asked for an oral hearing before the RAD.
issues.result_quote: Given that no new evidence was filed, the request for an oral hearing is denied.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD conducted a proper section 97 risk analysis before turning to the IFA
issues.applicant_position: The RPD skipped a proper s. 97 analysis and misread the risk, which is about retaliation for leaving the PCC area.
issues.result_quote: Counsel submits that the RPD failed to conduct a proper section 97 analysis. I agree.

issues.issue: Whether the PCC could find the Appellants in Rio or Brasilia (geographic reach of the PCC)
issues.applicant_position: The PCC can easily locate them through police, judiciary and databases; RPD ignored this.
issues.result_quote: I agree with counsel that the RPD ignored the geographical reach of the PCC.

issues.issue: Whether relocation to Rio or Brasilia would be reasonable
issues.applicant_position: Risk exists in the proposed IFA areas, so relocation is not viable.
issues.result_quote: The RPD did not err on this question, given that the applicable test has two prongs.

issues.issue: Whether the Appellants were personally targeted by the PCC, and whether the RPD wrongly found a chance encounter
issues.applicant_position: The female Appellant was targeted at home, so the PCC would find them elsewhere.
issues.result_quote: The matter must be sent back to the RPD for a proper assessment of their risk profile before a determination can be made.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in excluding the principal Appellant under Article 1E yet applying s. 97 with Brazil as country of reference
issues.applicant_position: Brazil should not have been used as his country of reference for s. 97.
issues.result_quote: The RPD erred by failing to explain why it interpreted article 1E and its applicable jurisprudence in this way.
